title: Ore and More

{{Infobox Location |image= File:BotW Ore and More.png |caption= |game= BotW |other= |inhab=[[Pelison]] |items= |related= |season= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Ore and More||Series, BotW}} is a [[Jewelry Shop]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|Ore and More|Sign|BotW}} ==Features and Overview== Ore and More is a [[Jewelry Shop]] in [[Tarrey Town]] that sells a small selection of [[Gem]]s at a high price. It opens after [[Pelison]] moves to Tarrey Town with his brother, [[Greyson]], during the "[[From the Ground Up]]" [[Side Quest]]. Upon discovering that the boulders Greyson was destroying contained many Gems, Pelison opened up the Shop.{{Cite|My little brother, Pelison, even started an ore shop. Check it out when ya get a chance!|Greyson|BotW}}{{Cite|Once we started breakin' up the rock here, we found that it's rich in {{Color BotW|Blue|ore}}. So I've decided to open up shop! I'm not sure why we have so much ore here, but maybe it's because we're close to {{Color BotW|Blue|Death Mountain}}. Anyway, these here are freshly mined. Be sure to buy a whole bunch!|Pelison|BotW}} Any Gems purchased at Ore and More are restocked by Greyson.{{Cite|I'm all sold out! I'll have to ask my big bro to go and dig up some more!|Pelison|BotW}} Whenever [[Link]] buys a Gems, Pelison will thank him and promise to restock soon.{{Cite|Thanks, brother! I'm all out now... I'll have to stock up again.|Pelison|BotW}} ===Wares and Pricing=== {{Wares|game= BotW |- |{{Wares/Item |item= Sapphire |price= 1,040 |stock= 1 |description= A precious blue gem mined from natural rock formations. Sapphires contain the very essence of ice. They've been known to fetch a high price since ancient times. }} |- |{{Wares/Item |item= Diamond |price= 2,000 |stock= 1 |description= The most precious gem one can find in Hyrule, its signature sparkle has charmed Hyruleans for generations. As such, it has sold for a very high price since ancient times. }} |- |{{Wares/Item |item= Topaz |price= 720 |stock= 1 |description= This precious yellow gem contains the power of electricity. It's been known to fetch a high price since ancient times. }} |- |{{Wares/Item |item= Ruby |price= 840 |stock= 1 |description= A precious red gem mined from large ore deposits found throughout Hyrule. Rubies contain the power of fire and have fetched a high price since ancient times. }} }} ==Trivia== * The [[Sign]] next to Ore and More bears [[Hylian (Language)|Hylian]] text that translates to "O and re," an erroneous transcription of "Ore and More."{{Cite|{{Script|Hylian BotW|O}}
